description: Test the functionality of logging in using Okta as an authentication provider and ensure the user is redirected to the dashboard upon successful login.
steps: Navigate to the login page at https://dev.roost.ai/login.
Redirect to the Okta login page.
Enter valid Okta credentials (username and password).
Confirm and submit the login form.
Validate the redirection back to https://dev.roost.ai.
Verify the presence of a user-specific dashboard or account details.
expected_results: User is successfully redirected to the Okta login page.
User can authenticate using valid credentials.
User is redirected back to https://dev.roost.ai.
User sees a personalized dashboard or account overview.
edge_cases: User's Okta account is locked or disabled.
The Okta login button is disabled or missing.
Incorrect configuration of Okta redirect URL.
data_requirements: Pre-configured Okta integration for the application.
A user account with appropriate permissions.
Session cookies for maintaining login state.
dependencies: The redirection URL is correctly set up in Okta.
User account exists and is active in the Okta system.
performance_metrics: Measure the time taken for redirection to the Okta login page.
Measure the time taken for redirection back to the dashboard.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the 'Okta' button has an accessible name or ARIA label.
Confirm that keyboard navigation allows interaction with the 'Okta' button.
Validate that color contrast meets WCAG standards.
